summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Fidelity Fundamental Large Cap Value ETF (FFLV) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in large cap equity. The fund is an actively managed fund that provides exposure to large-cap value stocks from around the world. The fund selects equity securities based on fundamental research and analysis. FFLV was launched on Feb 22, 2024 and is issued by Fidelity.

holdings.infoBox: FFLV is an equity ETF with a total of 123 individual holdings. The top holdings are Amazon.com stock at 6.34%, Apple at 5.14%, Microsoft at 5.13%, ExxonMobil Holdings at 4.17%, and Net Other Assets at 3.78%.
